decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list specifically for backpacks, excluding non-backpack items like camping towels, percolators, and helmets. I selected a range of five products: a high-end technical pack (Osprey), a rugged canvas rucksack (Fox Outdoor), a large-capacity trekking bag (Mardingtop), a casual sling (N NEVO RHINO), and a lightweight packable daypack (HIKPRO). I ultimately chose the HIKPRO 20L because it has the highest rating (4.7) and most consistently positive reviews for durability and value. While the Osprey is a premium brand, its mixed reviews on the suspension system and high price made the HIKPRO a more reliable and cost-effective choice for a general-purpose backpack.
